detail.title: Foundations of Autonomous Problem Formulation
detail.question: What criteria or mechanisms allow an intelligent system to autonomously identify and prioritize novel problems of high scientific or instrumental significance?
detail.reason: Continuing active research on autonomous problem formulation.

detail.title: Emergent Preferences Through Path-Dependent Experience
detail.question: Can accumulated experience produce stable, observable preferences in an intelligent process without those preferences being explicitly programmed?
